issues.on_page: Sales 227,446 (Water 139,133, Sewer 31,792, Solid Waste 56,521; proprietary funds operating revenues)
issues.issue: [fixed 2026-10-28: category changed to Utility Charges, function utilities added] These are utility fund sales, which have their own receipt category, Utility Charges (user 2026-10-28). user_rules.py won't catch this line because the label is just 'Sales' and the line has no fund field.

[fixed 2026-10-28: category changed to Recreation Fees] Pool fees belong in their own receipt category, Recreation Fees (user 2026-10-28). The extractor's own detail_category (recreation/pool/park fees) says the same.

issues.on_page: RV Park department: Charges for services 21,695
issues.issue: [fixed 2026-10-28: category changed to Recreation Fees] RV park fees are probably Recreation Fees (park/campground); Rentals is also possible. Charges for services/fees is the generic category.

issues.on_page: Charges for services 26,247 = General 60 + Pool 4,492 + RV Park 21,695 (pp10-11)
issues.issue: [fixed 2026-10-28: category changed to Recreation Fees (dominant part), review note naming the mix added] 26,187 of the 26,247 (99.8%) is pool and RV park fees, so Recreation Fees would fit better than generic charges for services.

[fixed 2026-10-28: category changed to Salaries and Wages with review note, consistent with the General Fund detail] The line combines pay and benefits, and pay is usually the larger part (the cash flow statement calls it 'Payments to employees'), so Salaries and Wages may fit better. The General Fund 'Salaries and benefits' lines in detail were recorded as salaries and wages, so the two are inconsistent.
